name: Hairstyle

Asymmetrical Bob.prompt: A chin-length straight haircut where one side is longer than the other, featuring a deep side part and smooth texture.

Blunt Bob.prompt: A sharp, chin-length straight haircut with a horizontal straight-across fringe and no layers.

Bubblegum Twin Tails.prompt: bright bubblegum pink twin tails with oversized curls, glossy bangs, and playful idol energy

Butterfly Cut.prompt: A long hairstyle featuring short, face-framing layers at the top that curve outward, paired with long, voluminous bottom layers.

Candy Bob.prompt: short pastel candy-colored bob with rounded volume and cute straight bangs

Curtain Bangs.prompt: Long, face-framing layers parted in the middle to create a curve around the eyes, blending into straight, waist-length hair.

French Bob.prompt: A chin-length straight haircut with blunt ends and short, straight-across bangs, characterized by a glossy, smooth hair texture.

Galaxy Gradient.prompt: long galaxy gradient hair fading from midnight blue to violet to pink with soft shimmering waves

High Ponytail Ribbons.prompt: long high ponytail with colorful ribbons, bouncy ends, and face-framing bangs

Hime Cut.prompt: Straight long hair with blunt-cut sidelocks ending at the cheekbones and straight-across bangs.

Hime Idol Cut.prompt: sleek hime cut with vivid magenta highlights, blunt sidelocks, and polished anime idol styling

Kawaii Buns.prompt: double space buns with pastel streaks, soft curls, and cute youthful framing strands

Micro Bangs.prompt: A straight hairstyle with extremely short, straight-across bangs ending well above the eyebrows and long, straight hair.

Neon Pixie.prompt: textured pixie cut in vivid teal with side-swept bangs and energetic cosplay styling

Pixie Cut.prompt: A short golden cropped hairstyle on the sides and back, with longer, wispy hair on the top and soft, feathered edges.

Rainbow Side Braid.prompt: thick side braid with rainbow-dyed sections and soft wispy bangs

Red Hair.prompt: long red hair, with two small ponytails at the top of her head with bangs

Sakura Curls.prompt: long sakura pink curls with airy volume and delicate youthful bangs

Shaggy Mullet.prompt: A high-contrast hairstyle with short, messy layers on the top and long, feathered hair reaching the shoulders at the nape.

Sunset Waves.prompt: long layered waves in a sunset orange-to-rose gradient with lively youthful movement

Two Tone Lob.prompt: shoulder-length lob with split-dye pastel blue and pastel pink colors and soft curled ends

Wolf Cut.prompt: A multi-layered, choppy haircut with high volume at the crown and thin, tapered ends, featuring a matte, textured finish.

Braided Silver Hair.prompt: Long, flowing silver hair tied in a single thick braid with leather wraps.

Buzz Cut.prompt: A uniform buzz cut with a sharp perimeter line.

Curly Top.prompt: A curly top with a high fade and defined ringlets.

Dreadlock.prompt: A dreadlock crown with a shaved temple fade.

Final Fantasy.prompt: Gravity-Defying Spikes: Large, chunky, and distinct yellowish spikes tufts that stick out from the crown

Goku.prompt: Vibrant blue spiky anime hair with sharp peaks and layered chunks.

Ivy League.prompt: Short ivy league man cut with a subtle side sweep, blonde hair.

Man Bun.prompt: A long man bun tied at the crown with shaved sides.

Modern Textured Quiff.prompt: A man's haircut featuring a high skin fade on the sides and back, with a three-inch long top styled into a dense, textured quiff. The hair is dark espresso in color with a matte finish, showing distinct strand separation and coarse texture. High-contrast studio lighting emphasizes the individual hair grains and the volume at the forehead.

Mohak.prompt: A mohawk with neon green highlights and a shaved base.

Mullet.prompt: A modern mullet with a tapered neck and layered top.

Pompadour.prompt: A high-profile pompadour with slicked-back sides and a high-shine black hair finish.

Side Part.prompt: A classic side part with a high skin fade and matte wax finish.

Side Sweep.prompt: A disconnected undercut with a long top swept to one side.

Sleek Middle Part - Blonde.prompt: A sleek, man style, straight middle part with blonde hair reaching the shoulders.

Sleek No Part - Black.prompt: A sleek, man style, straight  with black hair reaching the shoulders.

Tapered Side Part.prompt: A masculine haircut featuring a sharp, linear side part. The hair on top is 3 inches long, styled with a smooth, flat texture and a matte finish. The sides are trimmed in a high skin fade that blends into the scalp. The hair color is a uniform dark espresso brown.

Textured Fringe.prompt: A messy textured fringe with a low taper fade and wavy texture.
